mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level (below 3.0%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate rise above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand expansion that boosts corporate earnings visibility, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved profit outlooks.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns with Rank IC above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 1.0% year-over-year (INDPRO > 110.0) signals manufacturing sector strength that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through expanded economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 110.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP level (GDPC1 above 11600.0) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate economic momentum.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for GDPC1 as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation above 2.5% year-over-year (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through higher real interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signal labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved economic confidence.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * PAYEMS) fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns with Rank IC above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 110.0 (INDPRO < 110.0) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit visibility, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through economic slowdown expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
